population_rule: count/retained_mass only by counting or summing over already-committed artifacts (source named per entry); PENDING otherwise; interpretation_change in {yes,no,unknown} — unknown is a legal answer

entries.reason: extraction failures drop filings from the event stream by family: parse failure, refusal, timeout/retry exhaustion (MAX_RETRIES)

entries.rerun_threshold: a new failure family, or any family exceeding 5% of intake in a week
